caption: The drawing features a cylindrical clay pot with a tan or light brown outer surface and a reddish-brown interior, visible from the top. The pot has two small handles on either side near the rim. On the front surface, there are two blue decorative marks that resemble stylized flowers or leaves, positioned to the left and right of center, with a curved line of smaller blue dots connecting beneath them. Near the upper rim, there is an oval stamp-like mark containing text, and just below it is an arrow pointing downward. The background is plain, and the artist's signature, "N. Amantea," appears in the lower right corner.
title: Crock
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
